rationale: The stock has recovered sharply from today's low of $27.51 to $31.02, now sitting at 96.6% of its intraday range and within 0.40% of the session high — an extremely extended position after a large gap-down. Price is well above VWAP ($28.61) and the 9-EMA ($29.68), suggesting the bounce is mature. Going long here risks buying near the high with limited upside before the prior close resistance at $31.00 (already at that level), while shorting into a strong momentum recovery with no news catalyst and elevated relative volume (7.14x) carries significant squeeze risk. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable at this moment.
